descriptions.en: Drop one or more files or folders onto NotchAny to copy their absolute paths to the clipboard. Multiple paths are separated by newlines. Supports all file types and folders.
descriptions.zh-Hans: 将一个或多个文件、文件夹拖入 NotchAny，即可把它们的绝对路径复制到剪贴板。多个路径按行分隔，支持所有文件类型和文件夹。

summaries.en: Copy full paths from dropped files and folders to the clipboard.
summaries.zh-Hans: 将拖入的文件和文件夹完整路径复制到剪贴板。
